top_issues.issue: List column does not adapt at narrow widths; names truncate and the main pane is starved
top_issues.evidence: At 760x640 the rail (64) + list (232) take 296 px (39%); 'Katherine Jo…', 'Grace Hop…', 'Dorothy Vaug…', 'Margaret Ha…' truncated; conversation text wraps at ~365 px
top_issues.fix: Below ~900 px window width shrink the list to 240 px total (avatar 32, drop the preview to one line) or collapse it to an overlay toggled from the header; in Calls hide the video icon until row hover to free 36 px for names

top_issues.issue: Composer scroll state shows a stray scrollbar in the button row and clips the top line
top_issues.evidence: Grey bar #8d8d8f (light) / #88888c (dark), 4x24 px at x=1166, y=726-750 beside the paperclip; glyph fragments of the previous line visible at y=553 directly under the 1 px focus border
top_issues.fix: Place the text-area scrollbar at the field's right edge spanning the text area only (x≈1240, y=560-745), keep 8 px top inner padding inside the scroll clip, and add an 8 px fade at the top edge when scrolled

top_issues.issue: Message hover toolbar has no surface of its own in dark mode
top_issues.evidence: Toolbar fill #26272c equals hovered-row fill #26272c (1.00:1); border #303137 is 1.33:1; in light the toolbar is #fff on #f0f0f2 (1.14:1) plus #dfdfe3 border
top_issues.fix: Raise the dark toolbar to #34353c (1.22:1 over the row) with a #454750 border and a 0 2 8 rgba(0,0,0,.45) shadow; in light keep #fff but use a #c4c6cd border

top_issues.issue: Light surface ladder is too flat; selection and panes separate mainly by hairlines
top_issues.evidence: Rail #ececee vs sidebar #f6f6f7 1.09:1; sidebar vs main #fff 1.08:1; selected row #e2e3e8 vs sidebar 1.19:1; pane divider/header rule #dfdfe3 1.33:1; skeleton bars 1.19:1
top_issues.fix: Rail #e6e7ea, sidebar #f3f4f6, selected row #d2d4da (1.35:1 on #f3f4f6), pane divider #d3d5da; skeleton bars #dadbe0

top_issues.issue: Accent is overloaded, and in light mode it reads brown rather than as the dark-mode orange
top_issues.evidence: #a5500f (light) / #e88c3e (dark) used for unread times, unread dots, rail badge, selection bar, focus ring, primary buttons, checkboxes, theme chip, segmented underline and @mention text
top_issues.fix: Keep accent for primary action, selection and focus; move unread time to strong text weight #1b1c1f (dark #e9e9ec) and keep only the dot in accent; keep #a5500f for accent text (5.18:1 on the #f6f6f7 sidebar) but use a brighter #b85a12 for filled buttons and checkboxes (white text 4.66:1) so light reads orange, not brown

top_issues.issue: Popover rows are denser than the main lists and footers crowd the content
top_issues.evidence: Switcher rows 50 px with name/preview baselines 18 px apart; footer hints at y=623 only 33 px after last row text (590), footnote 27 px under hints; mention row avatar 22 px with name/email 15 px apart
top_issues.fix: Switcher rows 56 px with 20 px name/preview gap and 28 px avatars; add a 1 px #dfdfe3 rule and 12 px padding above the hint footer; mention rows 44 px with 28 px avatar

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is sparse and its status colours are unexplained
top_issues.evidence: Detail card 720x100 px with two rows (Organizer, Online); no attendees, response or agenda; dots: Focus time green #1b7a42, selected meeting grey; right 166+ px of pane empty
top_issues.fix: Add an Attendees row (avatars + count) and your response; give the meeting body a 14 pt section under a 11 pt caps caption; use green dot only with a 'Now' label and a neutral dot elsewhere, or drop dots

top_issues.issue: Vertical rhythm inside dialogs and cards is inconsistent
top_issues.evidence: Shortcuts: NAVIGATION caption→first row 41 px vs APP→first row 28 px; setup card: title→paragraph ~6 px, paragraph→button 12 px, field groups 24 px; settings name/email 17 px apart; sign-in-failed error line 0 px under title
top_issues.fix: Use one 4/8 scale: caption→content 8 px, title→body 8 px, body→actions 16 px, group→group 24 px; apply to shortcuts sections, setup and sign-in cards

top_issues.issue: Card and panel borders are faint, so cards rely on fill alone
top_issues.evidence: Channel post border #c4c6cd 1.71:1 (light), #454750 1.86:1 (dark); calendar/calls panel border #dfdfe3 / #303137 1.33:1; panel fill vs page 1.06-1.08:1
top_issues.fix: Post cards: border #b9bcc4 (light) / #4d4f58 (dark); recessed panels: fill #f1f2f4 (light) / #202126 (dark) so the panel reads without the border

top_issues.issue: Team tiles reuse the same hue for different teams
top_issues.evidence: Engineering 'E' and Contoso 'C' tiles both magenta (~#c0446e); Product is orange-brown close to the accent
top_issues.fix: Hash team colour from the full team id across 8 distinct hues and exclude the accent hue range (20-35°)

top_issues.issue: Active-call band is low emphasis and lacks a leave control; narrow labels are ambiguous
top_issues.evidence: Band fill #f6f6f7 on #fff (1.08:1); actions 'Phone', 'Expand', 'Hide' at 380 px; no hang-up
top_issues.fix: Tint the band with a 6% green (#eef6f1 / #17241c), add a red 'Leave' pill on the right, and use 'Phone', 'Full window', 'Hide bar' with tooltips

top_issues.issue: Selected state of the Fit/100% segmented control combines fill and underline
top_issues.evidence: 'Fit' has #e2e3e8 fill plus a 2 px #a5500f underline inside the pill, unlike every other selected control
top_issues.fix: Use the same selected treatment as the theme chips (filled pill, no underline) or a neutral raised segment with 600 weight

top_issues.issue: Thumbnails of extreme aspect ratios show mostly empty tiles; captions show pixel dimensions
top_issues.evidence: 3072x256 and 256x3072 images render as a 6 px strip in a 144x96 tile; captions '3072 × 256' at 12 pt
top_issues.fix: Crop thumbnails to fill (object-fit cover) and show file size or name; keep dimensions for the preview dialog

top_issues.issue: Retry button is undersized next to the error line
top_issues.evidence: Retry 58x26 px vs 32 px tall secondary buttons elsewhere; row tint #f9eeee 1.14:1
top_issues.fix: Make Retry a 28-32 px secondary button, and add a 3 px #b42525 (dark #f58a8a) left bar to the failed row like the mention row

top_issues.issue: Permanent composer hint line repeats what the placeholder says and adds a 12 pt row everywhere
top_issues.evidence: 'Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Markdown formatting works' always visible under every composer, alongside '· @ to mention' in the placeholder
top_issues.fix: Show the hint only while the composer is focused and empty, or move it into the shortcuts dialog

top_issues.issue: Inter's wide hyphen opens visible gaps in short tokens
top_issues.evidence: 'On-call', 'go/no-go', 'Sign-in', 'F4KQ-9TZW' render with ~4 px gaps either side of the hyphen
top_issues.fix: Use U+2011 non-breaking hyphen with tighter spacing in the bundled font, or set Inter's 'case'/'tnum' features off for UI labels; for the device code use a monospace face
